subject: website
name: BasePaint Mini
summary: BasePaint Mini, a minimal BasePaint front end that compiles to one HTML file, open source (no licence file) in BasePaint/basepaint-mini. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: the app fetches the day's theme from basepaint.xyz/api, a server the site needs, besides reading through the visitor's own wallet.

connections.name: BasePaint API (basepaint.xyz/api)
connections.note: Theme read by the app once it runs with a wallet.
